{"command": "E=<email:d29caa5c>
echo "hash,date,type,files_changed,insertions,deletions,subject" > commit-log.csv
git log --author=$E --format='%h' | while read h; do
 d=$(git show -s --format=%ad --date=short $h); s=$(git show -s --format=%s $h)
 p=$(git show -s --format=%p $h | wc -w)
 t=code; [ $p -gt 1 ] && t=merge; echo "$s" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' && t=release
 st=$(git show --numstat --format= $h | awk '{a+=$1;d+=$2;n++} END{print n+0","a+0","d+0}')
 echo "$h,$d,$t,$st,\"${s//\"/\"\"}\"" >> commit-log.csv
done
awk -F, 'NR>1{c[$3]++} END{for(k in c)print k,c[k]}' commit-log.csv
git log --author=$E --no-merges --numstat --format= | awk '{a+=$1;d+=$2} END{print a,d}'
git log --author=$E --no-merges --format= --name-only | sort -u | sed 's/.*\.//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5; git log -1 --format=%s HEAD~0 >/dev/null; head -1 README* | head -3; grep '"name"' package.json"}
